title: File:Portrait statue of Gebu sitting cross-legged 02.jpg
desc:
object type: portrait statue
- description: portrait of Gebu, an old master of the royal treasury, sitting cross-legged on the floor, resting his hands on his thighs (attitude of prayer). The inscription contains a prayer to the god Amun, to whom the statue was dedicated
- production place: Egypt
